about: One short row per skill; src/domain/xv2/skill-sheet.ts expands each into a full catalog record. A row holds only what the wiki page says: a missing Ki cost, damage figure or source stays unknown. ki is in points (100 is one bar). flags lists only what the source states as true. grades are MODEL judgments by docs/ingest/catalog/GRADING.md: [grade 0-5, reason].

rows.name: Kamehameha
rows.ki_note: Charging to level 2 or 3 costs no extra Ki.
rows.description: The definitive Dragon Ball skill! Fire a Ki Blast that can be charged up to level 3!
rows.notes: A beam: 9 hits uncharged, 12 at level 2, 15 at level 3 in ideal conditions; fewer at long range, so its full damage is inconsistent. The wiki gives no damage figure.

sustained_damage: A multi-hit beam: 9 hits, up to 15 when charged.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Bending Kamehameha
rows.description: Enter additional input after firing to make the Kamehameha chase your opponent!

damage.note: One hit. Pressing the input again makes the beam track the target.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Spirit Bomb
rows.description: Collect energy and fire a fearsome Ki Blast! Release your stored energy whenever you want!
rows.notes: A stance: 2 to 3 seconds of startup, then press again to throw. If it misses it comes back like a boomerang for a second chance. The wiki gives no damage figure; its Riot Javelin page calls Spirit Bomb the strongest Ki Blast Super.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Kaioken Kamehameha
rows.description: Unleash a powerful Kaioken Kamehameha! It requires a lot of Ki to fire!

damage.note: 30% over 22 hits; knockback.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 30% per use. 25-34% is grade 4.
ki_economy: Costs 2 bars upfront; 2 bars is grade 3.

rows.name: Riot Javelin
rows.description: Changes into an aggressive Ki Blast when your Health is very low.
rows.notes: At short range it tracks in a full circle, hitting behind you too. Below 5,000 health (half a health bar) it becomes far stronger: the wiki calls it the second strongest Ki Blast Super then, behind Spirit Bomb. No damage figure is given.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Tyrant Lancer
rows.description: Fire Ki Waves as you advance!
rows.notes: You advance while charging, then fire a beam that hits once; it fires sooner up close. The wiki calls it fast and one of the more reliable combo enders. No damage figure is given.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: x10 Kamehameha
rows.ki_note: Charging through its five stages costs no extra Ki.
rows.description: A Ki Blast that can be charged with more power than a normal Kamehameha!
rows.notes: A beam with five charge stages: 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18 hits in ideal conditions. The wiki gives no damage figure.

sustained_damage: A multi-hit beam: 6 hits, up to 18 when fully charged.
ki_economy: Costs 2 bars upfront; 2 bars is grade 3.

rows.name: Masenko
rows.description: Fire a Ki Blast straight ahead! Use [back input] at the same time to Back Jump as you do it!
rows.notes: One fast hit with knockback. Holding back as you use it makes you backflip before firing. The wiki gives no damage figure.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
mobility: A built-in back jump before firing.

rows.name: Menacing Flare
rows.description: Unleashes a Ki Wave. Even if it misses, you will move behind the enemy and attack them.

damage.note: One hit either way: the beam, or, if it misses, a teleport behind the opponent and a kick.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
mobility: Teleports behind the opponent, but only as the follow-up when the beam misses.

rows.name: Ki Blast Cannon
rows.description: Fire an unblockable shockwave! If it hits, you'll have a chance to make a follow-up attack!

get.unknown: The owner has this skill, but the wiki page doesn't say where it comes from.

rows.notes: A fast shockwave. It staggers an opponent who is being juggled or is knocked down, and knocks a standing one back; it can be repeated once for free. The wiki calls its damage small and thinks its in-game description was swapped with Shockwave's, so 'unblockable' is not relied on. The wiki page gives neither its Ki cost nor where to get it.

burst_damage: The wiki only calls its damage small.
control: Knockback only; a stagger on juggled opponents.

rows.name: Finish Breaker
rows.description: A barrage attack that scatters Ki Blasts. You can also use it while jumping!

damage.note: 25% if all 19 small Ki balls hit.

rows.notes: Can be used while jumping.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 25% per use. 25-34% is grade 4.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Psycho Barrier
rows.description: Summon a barrier in to protect your immediate vicinity. You can expand the barrier up to two times with additional input.

damage.note: 2% per hit; knockback.

rows.notes: A barrier in front of you that protects from all attacks; extra input makes it bigger, up to twice.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 2% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
survivability: A barrier that blocks every attack from the front while it is up.

rows.name: Evil Explosion
rows.description: Fire a short range, powerful Ki Blast that can be charged up to Stage 3!
rows.notes: A short-range blast that charges up to stage 3; its hitbox reaches a little behind you. On block it deals heavy stamina damage: a little over 3 stamina bars at full charge. The wiki gives no damage figure.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Heavy stamina damage to a blocking opponent: a little over 3 bars at full charge.

rows.name: Light Grenade
rows.description: Charge this move by hitting the button repeatedly for Ki Blasts at maximum power!
rows.notes: Charged in three stages by pressing repeatedly, not by holding. Stage 1 only flinches; stage 2 stands a juggled opponent back up, stunned; stage 3 knocks them back. The wiki gives no damage figure.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: At stage 2 it holds the target in place: a juggled opponent is stood up and stunned.

rows.name: Evil Eyes
rows.description: Set off an explosion at your enemy's destination! A long-range attack!
rows.notes: A remote explosion at the opponent's position, or in their path if used in a combo; it deals more damage outside a combo. The wiki compares it with Flash Strike: slower to come out, less recovery. No damage figure is given.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Paralyze Beam
rows.description: Fire a Ki Wave backwards! It'll make any opponent stagger a bit!
rows.notes: Fires behind you, at short range. A hit stuns the opponent for a moment. The wiki gives no damage figure.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: a hit stuns them for a moment.

rows.name: Destructo-Disc
rows.description: A move that fires a disc shaped Ki Blast! Though slow in speed, it has great homing, and cannot be guarded as well.
rows.notes: One slow disc with a long startup and mild tracking. It can't be blocked, though blocking reduces its damage a little, and a hit stands the opponent back up. The wiki says it can't be comboed without a hard knockdown. No damage figure is given.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: An unblockable hit that also stands the opponent back up.

rows.name: Turtle Style Last Resort
rows.description: Shock and paralyze the enemy! The paralysis will last a while, but it also takes a while to launch.

damage.note: 10% over 17 hits, and 2 seconds of paralysis.

rows.notes: You hold a stance for 2 seconds before the beam fires.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: 2 seconds of paralysis.

rows.name: Ki Blast Thrust
rows.description: Charge with Ki focused in your fist. Cancel out weak Ki Blasts as you run.

damage.note: One punch that blasts the opponent away.

rows.notes: A stance, then a rushing punch. Regular Ki Blasts don't stop it.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
survivability: Blocks some incoming attacks: regular Ki Blasts don't stop it.

rows.name: Dodon Ray
rows.description: Fire rapid Ki waves from your fingers. They'll be weak compared to other Ki Waves, but if they hit you'll be able to immediately move with a Boost Dash or Step!

damage.note: One hit that launches the opponent.

rows.notes: A quick thin beam. After a hit you can move at once with a Boost Dash or Step and continue the combo. The wiki's infobox lists 0 Ki used, which looks like a placeholder, so the cost is left unknown.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
control: Knockback only: it launches, and you can follow up.

rows.name: Tri-Beam
rows.description: Once ready, press the same button again to release a Tri-Beam! It can be charged, but the recoil from charging it too much will restrict your movement. A charged Tri-Beam can't be blocked.

damage.note: 10% uncharged; 30% and unblockable at full charge.

rows.notes: A stance, then press again to fire a short-range triangle of Ki. A full charge leaves you exhausted for 2 seconds.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use, 30% at full charge. Graded on the full 30%: 25-34% is grade 4.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: An unblockable hit when fully charged.
survivability: A full charge leaves you exhausted for 2 seconds.

rows.name: Double Sunday
rows.description: Fire 2 Ki Blasts straight ahead. Use [↓] while firing for a V-shaped Ki Blast!

damage.note: A pair of beams for 10%; at some distances they hit a second time as the opponent flies back, for 20%.

rows.notes: Pressing back while firing spreads the two beams into a V.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use, 20% when the second hit lands; graded on the 10%. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Saturday Crash
rows.description: Fire a Ki Blast that paralyzes your enemy. It won't last long, but it's easy. You won't be vulnerable.

damage.note: One Ki ball, and 1 second of paralysis.

rows.notes: The wiki notes its very quick recovery: enough time to fly to the paralyzed opponent and attack.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: 1 second of paralysis, with time to follow up.

rows.name: Shining Friday
rows.description: Fire a powerful Ki Blast in front of your eyes. Damages your enemy or cancels their Ki Blasts.

damage.note: 10% over 12 hits; knockback.

rows.notes: A Ki ball held in front of you at short range. It also absorbs regular Ki Blasts.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
survivability: Blocks some incoming attacks: it absorbs regular Ki Blasts.

rows.name: Bomber DX
rows.description: Fire a Ki Blast that cancels even strong Ki Blasts! Careful though, it has a long activation period.

damage.note: One hit; knockback.

rows.notes: Charges for a second before firing. It absorbs Ki Blasts and charged Ki Blasts.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
survivability: Blocks some incoming attacks: it absorbs Ki Blasts and charged Ki Blasts.

rows.name: Genocide Shell
rows.description: Fire 4 unmoving Ki Blasts forward!

damage.note: 5% for each of the four Ki balls an opponent runs into.

rows.notes: Throws out four small Ki balls that stay in place for 8 seconds, until you throw another set, or until an opponent runs into them.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use for each ball; graded on one ball, since the wiki doesn't say all four land together. Under 8% is grade 1.
sustained_damage: One hit per ball, and only if the opponent walks into them.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Galick Gun
rows.ki_note: Charging to stage 2 or 3 costs no extra Ki.
rows.description: Takes less time to charge than the Kamehameha, although not quite as powerful.
rows.notes: A beam like Kamehameha: 9, 12 and 15 hits at its three charge stages in ideal conditions. The wiki says it deals less damage than Kamehameha but charges faster. No damage figure is given.

sustained_damage: A multi-hit beam: 9 hits, up to 15 when charged.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Flash Strike
rows.description: Trigger an explosion at your enemy's destination. Attack again to increase the damage!
rows.notes: A remote explosion at the opponent's position, or in their path after a knockback, where it deals more damage. Quick to come out, with long recovery if it wasn't part of a combo. The wiki calls its damage after a knockback very fair and gives no figure.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Shine Shot
rows.description: Fire a Ki Blast while jumping to the side! Use [←] or [→] to change the direction you move. You can also immediately move with a Boost Dash or Step after firing!

damage.note: One small Ki ball.

rows.notes: You jump to the side as you fire, right by default and left if you press left. After firing you can move at once with a Boost Dash or Step.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
mobility: A built-in side jump as it fires.

rows.name: Earth Splitting Galick Gun
rows.description: Fire a more powerful Galick Gun than usual! Take note of how much Ki it uses!
rows.notes: A large beam, up to 23 hits, that fires as fast as an uncharged Galick Gun. The wiki puts its damage about 30% above a fully charged Galick Gun and gives no absolute figure.

sustained_damage: A multi-hit beam: up to 23 hits.
ki_economy: Costs 2 bars upfront; 2 bars is grade 3.

rows.name: Recoome Eraser Gun
rows.description: Spew a powerful Ki attack from your mouth. It will take a while to launch.

damage.note: A beam for 30%; the number of hits isn't given.

rows.notes: You pose for 2 seconds before the beam fires. It knocks the opponent away.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 30% per use. 25-34% is grade 4.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Crusher Ball
rows.description: Jump high, like in a volleyball attack, then fire a Ki Blast.

damage.note: 10% over 6 hits; it launches the opponent.

rows.notes: You jump high, then throw a Ki ball that wobbles and partly tracks the opponent.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Milky Cannon
rows.description: A Ki Blast that stops in midair! Chargeable. Charge length changes stopping point.

damage.note: One Ki ball that blasts the opponent back.

rows.notes: The ball travels a short way quickly, then crawls for 3 more seconds. Charging makes it travel further before it slows.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Death Beam
rows.description: Input commands as a series to launch up to 3 Ki Blasts quickly!
rows.notes: A quick finger beam of medium reach. Pressing again fires up to two more at no extra Ki, and each one re-aims if the last missed. It stands the opponent back up, and pushes a blocking opponent away. The wiki gives no damage figure.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Death Slash
rows.description: Fire a fast, blade-shaped Ki Blast. The blast has limited range, but fires quickly and remains for a short time after being fired.

damage.note: One lingering Ki wave that blasts the opponent away.

rows.notes: A slash through the air in front of you: short range, quick, and it lingers for a moment.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Death Slicer
rows.description: Launch disc-shaped Ki Blasts. Press again after you throw to aim discs at the enemy. Be careful though, because you can't guard!

damage.note: 7% for each hit; one or two hits.

rows.notes: A thrown disc. Pressing again a second after throwing makes it track the opponent. It stands the opponent back up. The in-game description's line about guarding is ambiguous, so whether it can be blocked is not recorded.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 7% per use for each hit; graded on one hit. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Death Wave
rows.description: Fire a Ki Blast that slashes an opponent vertically!

damage.note: One Ki wave; knockback.

rows.notes: A Ki wave like Death Slash that travels further.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: God Breaker
rows.description: Pose to stop a Strike attack. If you succeed, freeze your enemy and fire Ki Blasts!
rows.notes: A counter pose. If any strike, melee attack or grab hits you while it is active, you stun the opponents around you and blast the one who hit you. The wiki notes its long active window and that it works all around you. No damage figure is given.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: A counter: it stuns nearby opponents and blasts the attacker.
survivability: Blocks some incoming attacks: strikes, melee attacks and grabs during the pose.

rows.name: Change The Future
rows.description: Pose to stop a Strike Attack. If you succeed, move right to your enemy and fire a Ki Blast!
rows.notes: A counter pose. The in-game description says it stops a Strike attack, but the wiki's properties say it triggers on Ki Blasts and Ki Blast skills: you turn invisible, move to the opponent and blast them, and can't be interrupted during that part. The blast doesn't break guard or armor. No damage figure is given.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: A counter: you move to the attacker and blast them.
mobility: A teleport as the follow-up to a successful counter.
survivability: Blocks some incoming attacks: Ki Blasts during the pose, per the wiki's properties.

rows.name: Finish Buster
rows.description: Fire powerful Ki Blasts straight ahead. Careful, you'll be wide open!

damage.note: One large Ki ball; knockback.

rows.notes: Thrown quickly, but you hold the stance for 2 seconds afterwards and are open while you do.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Double Buster
rows.description: Fire a two-handed Ki Blast forward. Press the button again to chase after your opponent.

damage.note: One two-handed beam; knockback.

rows.notes: Pressing again makes the beam track the opponent.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Thunder Eraser
rows.description: Charge and ram from the front to bewilder your enemy!

damage.note: One rushing hit.

rows.notes: You charge forward hand-first. The wiki's text says a hit leaves the opponent blinded for 2 seconds, while its summary line calls the hit paralyzing; the two don't agree, so control is not graded.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Power Blitz
rows.description: Fire two Ki Blasts in a pincer attack!

damage.note: 15% in total from two Ki Blasts.

rows.notes: The two blasts loop around to the opponent's back.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Perfect Shot
rows.description: Fire powerful Ki Blasts from your fingers! Be careful, as it takes some time before it activates.
rows.notes: Charges for a while, then throws a blast that tracks mildly and hits about 9 times. It keeps hitting after you are free to move, so you can follow up or throw another. The wiki calls its damage very good for the price and gives no figure.

sustained_damage: A multi-hit blast: about 9 hits, and it can be repeated while the first is still hitting.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Innocence Bullet
rows.description: Poison your enemy and launch Ki Blasts!

damage.note: A pair of spiralling Ki Blasts, and poison.

rows.notes: You dance for a moment before firing; short range. A hit poisons the opponent until they die or use an antidote. The wiki doesn't give the poison's damage, so sustained damage is not graded.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 20% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Ill Flash
rows.description: Fire sweeping Ki Waves from your mouth.

damage.note: 15% over 6 hits; knockback.

rows.notes: A mouth beam that sweeps from left to right at medium range. The wiki also calls it "Gack!".

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Vanishing Ball
rows.description: Fire powerful Ki Blasts! Be careful, though, because it takes time to charge the attack!

damage.note: 20% over 9 hits; knockback.

rows.notes: You form a large Ki ball overhead, then throw it; it takes time to charge.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 20% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: DIE DIE Missile Barrage
rows.description: Attack by firing a barrage of Ki Blasts repeatedly. The Ki Blasts fire in a straight line.

damage.note: 15% in total over 21 Ki bullets; knockback.

rows.notes: The bullets fire in a straight line.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Galactic Donuts
rows.description: A powerful attack where you squeeze an opponent with a ring-shaped Ki Blast. Causes a large amount of damage.

damage.note: 40% if the ring catches the opponent; 10 hits and a hard knockdown.

rows.notes: You draw a ring overhead, then throw it. It only deals its damage if the opponent is caught in it.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 40% per use. 35% or more is grade 5.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: A thrown ring that grabs the opponent it catches, ending in a hard knockdown.

rows.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack
rows.description: A move where you create ghosts in front of you! The ghosts will automatically head towards the opponent.

damage.note: One ghost, and a stun.

rows.notes: You breathe out a ghost. It rushes the opponent when they come into range, or after 4 seconds.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: a hit stuns them.

rows.name: Big Bang Attack
rows.description: Fire powerful Ki Blasts! Hit the opponent with the Ki Blasts you're charging to deal extra damage!

get.unknown: The owner has this skill, but the wiki page doesn't say where it comes from.

rows.notes: A Ki sphere forms in front of your hand and damages on contact while it charges, then fires. It also blocks minor Ki Blasts. The wiki says most of its damage comes from the charging sphere, so it wants a close-range setup. No damage figure or hit count is given.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
survivability: Blocks some incoming attacks: minor Ki Blasts.

rows.name: Split Finger Shot
rows.description: Fire Ki Blasts from each of your fingers! The Ki Blasts will fly towards the opponent as if to prevent them from escape.

damage.note: 10% in total over 5 Ki bullets, and a stun.

rows.notes: One bullet from each finger; they track the opponent.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: the bullets stun on impact.

rows.name: Blaster Shell
rows.description: A move where you toss multiple Ki Blasts in succession. Time the button presses to fire in succession rapidly!

damage.note: 15% in total over 5 Ki balls; knockback.

rows.notes: Thrown slowly from alternating hands; pressing repeatedly speeds the throws up.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: God of Destruction's Wrath
rows.description: Fire Ki Blasts in all directions.

damage.note: 20% at most; one to five hits land.

rows.notes: You jump back and fire Ki Blasts around yourself in all directions. The wiki gives only the 20% maximum and says one to five hits land, so burst damage is not graded.

ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: the blasts stun.
mobility: A built-in back jump as it fires.
crowd_handling: Fires in all directions; no area damage is recorded.

rows.name: Feint Shot
rows.description: A move where you feint your attack with your Ki Blast. Hold the button to fire a Ki Blast on the first move. Release to attack instead on the second move.

damage.note: One Ki bullet.

rows.notes: You teleport left, then right, then fire. Holding the button fires after the first teleport instead. The wiki's summary line lists a stun on hit; its text doesn't describe one, so control is not graded.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
mobility: A built-in teleport to the side before it fires.

rows.name: Freezing Beam
rows.description: A move where you unleash Ki Waves that freeze the opponent.

damage.note: One beam, and the opponent is frozen for 3 seconds.

rows.notes: A long-range beam from the forehead.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 2% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: it freezes them for 3 seconds.

rows.name: Energy Wave Combo
rows.description: Fire two Ki Waves! Charge this move to fire up to 6!

damage.note: 10% from two beams; 15% from six beams at full charge.

rows.notes: A pair of thin beams at medium range; charging adds beams, up to six.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use, 15% at full charge. Graded on the full 15%: 15-24% is grade 3.
sustained_damage: A multi-hit beam: six beams at full charge.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Galick Beam Cannon
rows.description: A Ki Blast that can be charged.

damage.note: 10% over 9 hits; 15% over 15 hits at full charge.

rows.notes: The wiki says it works exactly like Galick Gun with a different look.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use, 15% at full charge. Graded on the full 15%: 15-24% is grade 3.
sustained_damage: A multi-hit beam: 9 hits, up to 15 when charged.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Infinity Explosion
rows.description: A Ki Blast that causes an explosion in the area. Charge the move to increase the size of the blast.

damage.note: 15% over 6 hits; 20% over 14 hits at full charge.

rows.notes: You charge, then set off an explosion around yourself at close range. Charging makes the blast bigger.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use, 20% at full charge. Either figure falls in 15-24%, which is grade 3.
sustained_damage: A multi-hit explosion: 6 hits, up to 14 when charged.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
crowd_handling: An explosion that damages the area around you; charging enlarges it.

rows.name: Prelude to Destruction
rows.description: Fire powerful, long-range Ki Waves from your fingers! If you hit an opponent, you'll break their guard!

damage.note: One thin beam; it also empties the opponent's stamina.

rows.notes: A long-range finger beam. On a hit it breaks the opponent's guard and takes all their stamina.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 2 bars upfront; 2 bars is grade 3.
control: A guard break that empties the opponent's stamina on hit.

rows.name: Elite Beam
rows.description: A beam attack from the Galactic Patrolman's ray gun.

damage.note: One thin beam; knockback.

rows.notes: Fired from a ray gun at medium range, with a pose.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Elite Shooting
rows.description: Fire the Galactic Patrolman's ray gun at random.

damage.note: 15% for a shot that lands; five shots go out in different directions.

rows.notes: Five ray-gun shots in different directions, then you stumble while putting the gun away.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use for a shot that lands; graded on one shot. 15-24% is grade 3.
sustained_damage: Up to five shots, fired in different directions.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Counter Burst
rows.description: An effective move against Ki attacks. Effectively stop your opponent's Ki blast, and you'll counter with an even more powerful Ki blast.

damage.note: 20% over 6 hits when the counter triggers; knockback.

rows.notes: You put up a barrier in front of you. If a Ki Blast skill hits it, you throw back a Ki bullet.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 20% per use when the counter triggers. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: A counter: it answers a Ki Blast skill with a blast that knocks back.
survivability: Blocks some incoming attacks: Ki Blast skills from the front.

rows.name: Emperor's Blast
rows.description: Spin and attack with a powerful Ki wave. Use this when you think you're about to be flanked.

damage.note: One Ki wave fired behind you, and a 3-second stun.

rows.notes: You turn and fire behind yourself; it only hits what is behind you.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: it stuns what it hits for 3 seconds.

rows.name: Eye Beam
rows.description: After inputting this command, use [Control Stick] to move and fire a beam!

damage.note: 5% in total from 3 small Ki bullets.

rows.notes: You move forward as you fire; pressing a direction moves you that way instead and fires at once. It stands the opponent back up.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
mobility: A built-in move in a chosen direction as it fires.

rows.name: Destructive Ray
rows.description: Fire beams from your eyes that shoot forward!

damage.note: A pair of eye beams, and a 1-second stun.

rows.notes: Medium range.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: Holds the target in place: it stuns them for a second.

rows.name: Super Explosive Wave
rows.description: Fire a powerful Ki Wave forward! Use [↓] while entering the command to backflip before firing. You cancel the attack by guarding after the backflip.

damage.note: Up to 10% across 10 hits; knockback.

rows.notes: The Super, not the Evasive of the same name. A very long beam from one hand. Pressing back makes you backflip before firing, and guarding after the backflip cancels the attack. The wiki says you can follow it with another attack or a boost dash.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
sustained_damage: A multi-hit beam: up to 10 hits.
ki_economy: Costs 2 bars upfront; 2 bars is grade 3.
mobility: A built-in back jump: an optional backflip before firing.

rows.name: Senko Ki Blast
rows.description: Fire a Ki Blast and blind your opponent! You'll jump into the air after firing.

damage.note: One Ki ball thrown at the ground.

rows.notes: Close range. You jump into the air after firing. The wiki's text says a hit blinds the opponent for 2 seconds, while its summary line calls it a stun; the two don't agree, so control is not graded.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 2% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Kill Driver
rows.description: Charge this Ki Blast by rapidly pressing the button! After firing, press the button again to make it explode!

damage.note: 5% uncharged; 15% at full charge.

rows.notes: A ring of energy. Pressing rapidly makes it larger, until it is too wide to hit normally; pressing again after launching makes it explode.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use, 15% at full charge. Graded on the full 15%: 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Sudden Storm
rows.description: Fire a series of evil Ki Blasts!

damage.note: 15% over 15 hits; knockback.

rows.notes: A barrage of scattering Ki bullets from one hand, at long range.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 2 bars upfront; 2 bars is grade 3.

rows.name: Darkness Twin Star
rows.description: Create 2 Ki Blasts around you! They can be used for either attack or defense! Additional input will fire them toward an opponent!

damage.note: 15% across both Ki balls when you fling them; knockback.

rows.notes: Two Ki balls circle you for 10 seconds; pressing again flings them at the targeted opponent. The in-game description says they can be used for defense, but the wiki doesn't say what they block.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Darkness Eye Beam
rows.description: Fire beams from your eyes that shoot toward the ground below you! Your face will gradually rise up and shoot the beams diagonally forward.

damage.note: A pair of eye beams; knockback.

rows.notes: The beams start at the ground in front of you and sweep upward, at medium range.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 15% per use. 15-24% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Gorgeous Shot
rows.description: Jump straight up and fire a Ki Wave directly below you!

damage.note: One beam fired straight down; knockback.

rows.notes: You jump straight up and fire below yourself, at close range. Used in a combo it tracks the opponent mildly.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Dodoria Beam
rows.description: Perform a palm heel strike and then launch a beam from your mouth! Your attack will still hit, even if the opponent moves behind you while firing. If used during a combo, you won't perform the strike.

damage.note: A palm strike, then a mouth beam; knockback.

rows.notes: In a combo it skips the palm strike and goes straight to the beam. The in-game description says it still hits an opponent who moves behind you while firing.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Chaos Shot
rows.description: Fire Ki Blasts in all directions, or charge up and unleash a concentrated beam in front of you!

damage.note: 10% over 2 hits fired in all directions; 15% over 9 hits when held and aimed forward.

rows.notes: Tapped, it fires Ki bullets in all directions; held, it concentrates them into a blast in front of you. The wiki says it is hard to dodge up close.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use, 15% when held. Graded on the held 15%: 15-24% is grade 3.
sustained_damage: A barrage fired once: 9 hits when held.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
crowd_handling: Fires in all directions when tapped; no area damage is recorded.

rows.name: Destruction's Concerto: Comet
rows.ki_note: The wiki lists 100-200 without saying when each applies.
rows.description: Places a Ki Blast that slowly follows you around. Combine this move with a Destruction's Conductor to shoot the Ki Blast off at top speed!

damage.note: 3% from one hit on its own. Combined with Destruction's Conductor it hits 13 times; the wiki leaves that damage figure blank.

rows.notes: A slow Ki ball that follows you around. Destruction's Conductor, a separate skill, shoots it at the opponent. The wiki lists it under DLC Super Pack 2.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 3% per use on its own. Under 8% is grade 1.
sustained_damage: A single hit on its own.

rows.name: God Splitter
rows.description: Generate a Ki Blast in front of you. Press a button to fire it, or guard to cancel the move.

damage.note: 5% over 10 hits; the wiki says 10% over 17 hits "if used just right".

rows.notes: You form a Ki ball in one hand; pressing again fires it, and guarding cancels it.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use, 10% if used just right; graded on the 5%. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Heavenly Arrow
rows.description: Fly up into the air and unleash a barrage of Ki Blasts. Perform the move while pressing [↑] to attack with an unblockable Ki-powered hand before the barrage.

damage.note: 7% over 8 hits; knockback. Pressing forward adds an unblockable stab and one more Ki bullet.

rows.notes: You fly backward and fire a barrage. Pressing forward as you use it stabs the opponent first with an unblockable hit.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 7% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
control: An unblockable hit when used with forward.
mobility: A built-in back jump: you fly backward as it fires.

rows.name: Sudden Death Beam
rows.description: A move that uses Instant Transmission. If you get attacked before you have a chance to move, you will slip behind your opponent and retaliate with a Ki Wave!

get.other: The wiki lists three sources: the TP Medal Shop, the STP Medal Shop and the Double Crystal Raid Battle.

rows.notes: A counter pose. If a basic, Strike or Ki Blast attack hits you, you teleport behind the attacker and fire a blast. If nothing hits you, the Ki is still spent and you teleport without attacking; you can't cancel into another Super, so it is easy to punish. The wiki gives no Ki cost and no damage figure.

control: A counter: it answers basic, Strike and Ki Blast attacks with a blast from behind.
survivability: Blocks some incoming attacks: basic, Strike and Ki Blast attacks during the pose.

rows.name: Trap Shooter
rows.description: Fire a volley of Ki Blasts in one go! You can cancel the move by performing additional input before the blast is released.

damage.note: 5% over 10 hits; knockback.

rows.notes: A volley of Ki balls at long range. Pressing again before it fires cancels it.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use. Under 8% is grade 1.
sustained_damage: Ten tracking hits in one volley.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Kairos Cannon
rows.description: Set up Ki Blasts and release them after a bit. The more Power of Time you collect, the more blasts you can set up-up to 12! If you add more, they'll all launch at once! But if you set up eight or more blasts, the attack will reset the accumulation of Power of Time.

damage.note: 5% from 4 Ki balls; up to 12 balls for 10% with Holy Inscription hits.

get.other: Conton City Tournament, Match 2 ("Thinning the Herd").

rows.notes: Four Ki balls form around you and fire on their own; pressing again fires them all at once. Holy Inscription, a separate skill, raises the count up to 12, and setting up eight or more resets the Power of Time you have collected.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 5% per use, 10% with Holy Inscription; graded on the 5%. Under 8% is grade 1.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.

rows.name: Temporal Holy Ray
rows.description: Set up clocks that fire Ki Waves after some time passes. You can delay the waves by holding the button. You can set up to three clocks based on how much Power of Time you've accumulated. Additional [Control Stick] input will fire the waves all at once!

damage.note: One beam from a clock sigil; knockback.

get.other: Conton City Tournament, Match 3 ("Time for the Quarterfinals!").

rows.notes: You place a clock sigil that fires a beam at the opponent. Holding delays it by up to 12 seconds, and another input fires it early. Holy Inscription, a separate skill, lets you place up to three.

burst_damage: Wiki damage 10% per use. 8-14% is grade 2.
ki_economy: Costs 1 bar upfront; 1 bar is grade 4.
